parameters.query:
WITH q AS (SELECT $1::vector AS v)
(
  SELECT 'offer' AS kind,
         format('Offer: %s (%s, %s). %s, from %s to %s. Price: %s DT per person. Seats left: %s. %s',
                o.title, d.city, d.country, o.duration, o."startDate"::date, o."endDate"::date,
                o.price, o."availableSeats", o.description) AS text
  FROM rag_chunks c
  JOIN travel_offers o ON o.id = c.offer_id
  JOIN destinations d ON d.id = o."destinationId", q
  WHERE o.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND o."availableSeats" > 0 AND o."startDate" > now()
    AND ($2::float < 0 OR o.price <= $2::float)
    AND ($3::int < 0 OR extract(month FROM o."startDate") = $3::int)
  ORDER BY c.embedding <=> q.v
  LIMIT 3
)
UNION ALL
(
  SELECT 'faq' AS kind, c.content AS text
  FROM rag_chunks c, q
  WHERE c.kind = 'faq'
  ORDER BY c.embedding <=> q.v
  LIMIT 2
)
